definitions.short: properly, apparently to heap ; figuratively, to chastise (as if piling blows); to gather grain
definitions.full: H6014. amar [ עִמֵּר ] verb Pi`el denominative bind sheaves (Late Hebrew id. , so ᵑ7 Psa 129:7 , compare Christian-Palestinian Aramaic Schw Idioticon 69 ); — Participle מְעַמֵּר 129:7 (in simile; || קוֺצֵר ). II. [ עָמַר ] verb Hithpa`el deal tyrannically with ( ב ) (Arabic cherish enmity, rancour, malice , III. plunge into a conflict, rancour, malice ); — Perfect 3masculine singular וְהִתְעַמֶּרֿ consecutive Deut 24:7 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּתְעַמֵּר 21:14 .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; specifically (as denominative from 6016 )

occurrences.englishText: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.
If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
